           KAOLINUM

        Bolus alba (China Clay) Alumina Silicate

        (KAOLIN)


A remedy for croup and bronchitis.



Nose.--  Itching and burning. Discharge   yellow.
        Sore, scabby  , stopped up.



Respiratory.--    Soreness of chest
        along trachea; cannot stand percussion. Gray sputa. Capillary bronchitis. Larynx and chest
        sore. Membranous croup-extends down trachea.



Dose.--  Lower triturations.
